correctness.rationale: The theorem follows by exhausting all possible supports using exact positive-definiteness and invasion-eigenvalue conditions. Two-leaf and hub-leaf principal minors forbid the remaining patterns; explicitly solved supports provide sharp thresholds. Standard-library exact-rational full support census passes for 84 cases k=2..4; the symbolic proof works for all k>=2. Excludes degenerate transition curves.

value.rationale: The natural ecological windmill motif has k repeated rival pairs linked by a shared competitive hub. Exact stable-community geometry, species abundances and two invasion thresholds identify when hub-inclusive coexistence, hub exclusion and hub-only bistability occur; the finite-strength chamber structure is not supplied by generic multiplicity/clique facts.
